name: ARDCO Rosseett Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Reach out to ARDCO Rosseett Manufacturing Corporation today for any assistance you need in creating your next electronic product. We offer the absolute best in engineering expertise, prototyping, manufacturing services and testing and rework options you can rely on.
about:
ARDCO Rosseett Manufacturing Corporation has operated from Norman, Oklahoma since 1989. The company describes itself as locally owned and operated, though founder names are not disclosed in public materials. It serves customers across Oklahoma and neighboring states.

The firm provides electronic system design, engineering support, prototyping, manufacturing services, and testing and rework for electronic products. Its capabilities span the full product lifecycle from concept through production, including design consultation, prototype fabrication, volume manufacturing, and post-production testing and rework. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers span the electronics sector, with the company serving the entire state of Oklahoma and surrounding states. Specific industry verticals or named clients are not listed, but the focus on electronic product creation suggests work with original equipment manufacturers and product developers in the region.

ARDCO emphasizes a one-year guarantee on all work performed and offers manufacturing cost estimates at no charge, positioning those policies as differentiators in its market. The company also highlights its local ownership as a point of distinction.
